description: Background job: plan and craft an item including intermediates (planks → sticks → tool) with the recipe book, using the 2×2 grid or a crafting table (walks to a nearby one, or places one from the inventory). Fails with the plan if materials are missing or a smelting step is needed.

waitSeconds.description: Block up to this many seconds for the job to finish before returning (default 0: return at once).

name: craft_item
title: Craft an item (job)
